high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an article discussing the discovery of an interstellar comet using the Gemini South telescope. The text at the top of the image reads: "Once these objects get too faint to see, they will never be seen again," which suggests the transient nature of celestial objects. Below the text, there are social media sharing icons for platforms like Facebook, Twitter (X), WhatsApp, Pinterest, Flipboard, and others, indicating that the article can be shared on various social media channels.
